content: {"episode_id":"ep-05019","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for episode ep-05019. The clinical indication note documents \"recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome,\" corresponding to the submitted diagnosis codes I49.5 and I48.0. The note further states that \"given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction\" (Z86.73), \"continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect arrhythmic events and guide anticoagulation and rate-control management.\" We therefore request reconsideration of the mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring claim on medical necessity grounds."}
